group_assessment.weighting: A founding WWOX laboratory working in its native competence (mouse mammary carcinogenesis, the floxed allele it generated). Observations (survival, whole-mount morphometry, IHC, arrays) are weighed above the interpretations (WWOX not a classical tumour suppressor; Stat3 as the Wnt5a route). Several supporting results are 'data not shown', and statistics rest on 3-5 animals per group. The group does not work on WWOX-related neurological disease and did not examine the nervous system.

entries.proposition: ALLELE: exon 1 of Wwox is floxed (this group's allele, ref 19). DATO. Downstream exons stay in the genome after deletion.

entries.proposition: DRIVER: BK5 promoter active in utero from E13.5 in epithelial precursors (cited ref 24). DATO about the citation. Where else BK5-Cre recombines was not mapped here: no reporter, no tissue survey of deletion (searched Methods and Results).

entries.proposition: CAUSE OF DEATH UNKNOWN, AND WHAT WAS NOT EXAMINED. Histopathology, haematology and blood chemistry found no cause. DATO. No brain histology, neurological examination, EEG, seizure observation or behaviour is described anywhere in the paper (searched brain, neur, seizure, CNS, behav: zero hits). This is absence of assessment, not evidence of absence.
entries.snippet: We performed comprehensive histopathological, hematological and blood chemistry analyses on these BK5-Cre Wwox KO mice before dead and could not determine a reason for the relatively sudden deaths.

entries.proposition: FIGURE S1, NATIVE PIXELS - THE MEAN CANNOT BE 115 DAYS. The red KO curve steps down from about 68 to about 117 days and crosses 50% near day 100. Arithmetic: with one death at 68 and none after 117, the largest possible mean for n = 22 is (68 + 21 x 117)/22 = 114.8, reachable only if the other 21 all died on day 117, which the staircase excludes; the median is about 100. Also on the panel: Cre(-) controls n = 13, a number the text never gives; all curves stop at about 118 days, so the plotted 100% heterozygote survival covers the KO window only, not the 'over a year' tumour follow-up.
entries.snippet: Visual attestation of Figure S1: red BK5-Cre(+) Wwox flox/flox curve n=22 descending from about 68 to about 117 days and crossing 50% near 100 days; blue Cre(-) flox/flox n=13 and green Cre(+) +/flox n=41 flat at 100% to about 118 days.

entries.proposition: FIGURE 2, NATIVE PIXELS. Box plots (median, box, whiskers) with p<0.001 in each panel on 3 mice per group; a box-and-whisker display and p<0.001 from 3 vs 3 animals suggest the technical triplicates were pooled as observations (INFERENZA; the test is not named). KO medians are about 13-15% of WT (A about 0.0003 vs 0.002; B about 0.00017 vs 0.0012), i.e. residual Wwox signal in KO organoids, whose source (unrecombined epithelium, stroma) is not addressed.

entries.proposition: FIGURE 3D-E, NATIVE PIXELS - HOW MUCH OF THE DEFECT IS CRE. D: Cre(-) WT about 5.45, Cre(+) WT about 4.05, Wwox KO about 2.35 branches/mm, SD bars, n = 4/4/5. Cre alone removes about 1.4 of the total 3.1 (about 45%); the Wwox-attributable part is KO vs Cre(+) WT (p = 0.018, per legend). E (MMTV, 24 weeks): WT about 6.8 vs KO about 3.8, matching the text; there the Cre(+) Wwox+/+ controls are pooled with Cre(-), so Cre toxicity cannot be separated in that model. A-C whole mounts are single representative fields, C an 'extreme case'.
